verdict.rationale: Trivy is CLI/CI-CD-oriented and community evidence confirms it is 'very easy to write automation around' and integrates smoothly into CI/CD pipelines, which supports background/automated runs, but this is traditional pipeline automation, not an AI-native agentic background automation setup. The MCP server (trivy-mcp) lets AI assistants query scan results conversationally, but there's no evidence of Trivy itself being configured to run autonomously as a background agent-triggered service. missing for 10: evidence of AI-agent-triggered scheduling/orchestration, autonomous recurring scans initiated by an AI agent, or first-party agentic automation framework beyond standard CI/CD cron-style hooks.
